chunks: For all that is in the heavens and the earth belongs to God; and God is sufficient as guardian.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about God's ownership of the heavens and the earth?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the concept of divine sovereignty (Tawhid al-Mulk), affirming that all creation belongs exclusively to Allah, thereby negating any independent agency in the universe. The concluding phrase 'wa kafa billahi wakila' serves as a source of spiritual comfort (Tawakkul), reminding believers that God’s protection is sufficient even amidst the trials of the believers of the Book mentioned in the preceding verses.
